Treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) are defined as AEs that started after the date/time of study drug administration. AE reported terms were coded using the Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Version 24.1.

Day = Date - Date of Injection (+ 1 if Date >= Date of Injection). Day is calculated only for complete dates.

[1] OD = Ocular dexter (right); OS = Ocular sinister (left); OU = Both eyes. * indicates study eye.

[2] Serious ?:
